title: Run Claude Code in CI: Auto-Review Every Pull Request
description:
Want AI to review every pull request? 🤖

✅ Add a workflow file in .github/workflows
✅ Trigger it on every pull request and use the Claude Code action
✅ Keep your key in a secret and add a review prompt
